industry.structure: Global agricultural supply chain and processing is scale-driven and cyclical: origination, crushing, refining, and nutrition sit on thin margins with periodic crush-spread and freight arbitrage. ADM, Bunge, Cargill, and Louis Dreyfus dominate origination and processing; nutrition and biofuels add higher-margin but smaller revenue pools.
industry.share_shift: ADM is pivoting capital toward nutrition and specialty ingredients (Alltech JV, human/animal nutrition) while core Ag Services and Oilseeds volumes remain tied to global crop flows and China export demand. Peers Bunge and BG are consolidating; ADM's relative share is stable but earnings power is mid-cycle, not peak.
industry.trend: Biofuels policy (renewable diesel, ethanol blending), South American crop competition, and China soybean/meal import patterns drive crush margins. Accounting and intersegment controls remain a governance overhang even after the 2026 SEC settlement.
